channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Saks Off 5th stores to close at Waikele, Ala Moana
item.description: Saks Global will be closing two Saks Off 5th stores in Hawaii as part of a strategic decision to close the majority of its Off 5th retail locations and remaining Last Call Stores nationwide.

item.title: Hawaii Police Commission picks Reed Mahuna as next chief
item.description: The Hawaii County Police Commission has chosen interim Police Chief Reed Mahuna as its next police chief, the Mayor’s Office announced today.

item.title: Apple reports record iPhone sales amid holiday bump
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO >> Apple reported record quarterly sales of the iPhone, thanks to new, higher-priced models, which enticed holiday shoppers and helped drive a rebound for the brand in China, the largest smartphone market in the world.

item.title: Don Lemon released without bond over Minnesota protest charge
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Former CNN anchor Don Lemon and three other people arrested on charges that they violated federal law during a protest at a church in St. Paul, Minnesota, were released today after initial court hearings.

item.title: No. 3 Hawaii men’s volleyball sweeps No. 14 Penn State
item.description: Adrien Roure put down a team-high 10 kills and Justin Todd was a perfect 6-for-6 on swings from the middle with six blocks to help No. 3 Hawaii sweep No. 14 Penn State 25-22, 25-23, 25-15 today at Rec Hall in University Park, Pa.

item.title: Senate passes deal to fund government, negotiate ICE limits
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The Senate passed a bipartisan spending package Friday to fund most of the government and keep the Department of Homeland Security running for two weeks while Democrats and President Donald Trump negotiate restrictions on the administration’s immigration crackdown.

item.title: U.S. Senate budget bill includes $75 million for Hawaii
item.description: The bipartisan funding package approved by the U.S. Senate today includes nearly $75 million in earmarks for Hawaii, according to U.S. Sen. Brian Schatz.

item.title: Hawaii health officials investigate chickenpox outbreak at Kauai school
item.description: The Hawaii Department of Health today said it is investigating an outbreak of chickenpox at Kilauea Elementary School on Kauai.

item.title: Kealakehe Elementary students involved in terroristic threatening incident
item.description: Hawaii island police are investigating an alleged threat made by a 9-year-old student at Kealakehe Elementary School.

item.title: Firefighters extinguish 16th floor fire at Makaha Valley Towers
item.description: Firefighters this morning extinguished a two-alarm blaze at a high-rise in Makaha.
